ice-sell.title: Stored goods and ice sold where a bid stands: stored null matter, methane and ice first, then the ice fields
ice-sell.note: Every route here is gated: a drain or carry opens only on goods the pilot itself stores and a fresh bid (requires.stored, requires.bid); a mine route only on a deep water-ice order at Central Nexus (300 units at its best price) and with an Ice Harvester I fitted. Drains and carries need no harvester. What miners store is sold before new ice is mined.

reserve-prism.title: Make, then gather what the reserve lacks: a loaded hold stored, steel plate from stored iron, then gold, silicon, nickel and carbon
reserve-prism.note: Orders ENT-050, block ZERO: iron and copper no more while the reserve holds them; P2: stored iron becomes steel plate. The iron gather fields left this template on 2026-11-17 23:20 UTC (Zero).

reserve-hamal.title: Gather what the reserve is short of: a loaded hold stored first, carbon, then iron, Ironhollow first
reserve-hamal.note: As reserve-prism with Ironhollow Fading Signal before Schedar and Hamal before Prism Scatter, so the division is spread over the iron fields. Needs the Mining Laser I.
